items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: I was happy to talk to him.

ctx.x: Tell you the funny thing. Me and him had the same accountant. I happened to be down in the accountant's office and he happened to call up, from Miami, Florida. He lives in Miami, Florida now. And the accountant told him that I was in the office. And put him on the phone, and he started to talking, and he was so happy to talk to me. I was happy to talk to him. Because I hadn't seen him or heard from him in years.
